notes.title: Cheap Car Repair - Game Title Update!
notes.notes:
Hi! We have a quick announcement for you.
The game’s title is getting a slight makeover in the English version.

Why? 
We’re aiming for better visibility, so we’re changing the title to something a bit less generic and more in line with the game’s theme.

You might be wondering what we came up with? 
Well, it took us not a day, not two… Actually, we didn’t really think at all. And so we ended up with:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/f50741aa981d367bb8a718386e8fa982e233ed95.png

We figured a game about sloppy repairs deserved a sloppy title rework to match!

We’re hoping this change will bring us fame, fortune, and the glory we’ve always dreamed of. Cheers!
~ Little Dog Games
